story.originalTitle: "The fact that between Singapore and Austin, two very different circuits, we've unlocked performance – we’d like to build on that, and I hope we can...
story.summaryEn:
"The fact that between Singapore and Austin, two very different circuits, we've unlocked performance – we’d like to build on that, and I hope we can fight hard in Mexico.” 🗣️ AK
Finishing off race day in Austin with Ayao, Esteban and Ollie 🇺🇸
#HaasF1 #F1 #USGP
detailZh:
“在新加坡和奥斯汀这两个截然不同的赛道上，我们解锁了性能——我们希望在此基础上继续进步，并希望我们能在墨西哥站全力以赴。” 🗣️ AK
在奥斯汀站与阿亚奥、埃斯特班和奥利一起结束赛车日 🇺🇸
#哈斯F1 #一级方程式 #美国大奖赛
detailEn:
"The fact that between Singapore and Austin, two very different circuits, we've unlocked performance – we’d like to build on that, and I hope we can fight hard in Mexico.” 🗣️ AK
Finishing off race day in Austin with Ayao, Esteban and Ollie 🇺🇸
#HaasF1 #F1 #USGP
